games.title: The Golden Keep: Forces of Darkness
games.description: Gather timber, raise a settlement and command the forces that defend it. Humans, orcs, black dwarves and gargoyles each bring a different people to the struggle. Your army begins with the workers and homes behind it.

games.title: SWARM
games.description: Guide a moving collective of 134 specialist craft. Scouts find the trouble, carriers share energy and repair craft keep their neighbours moving. Choose when to advance and when to gather everyone back together.

games.title: Iron Litany
games.description: Work with a cannon crew through three watches. A playable early edition, with art, audio and balance still in review.

games.title: Pixie Garden
games.description: The current Pixie Garden development demo. Available for Linux, with Windows and controller coverage still in development.

games.title: Chantilly
games.description: Welcome eight guests to Chantilly, take their coats and follow the conversation from room to room. You know the house; now you must get to know the people in it. An interruption turns an evening of service into a mystery.

games.title: Wrong Places
games.description: Eleven ordinary-looking places refuse to follow ordinary rules. A coastal walk, a small theatre, a quiet room and an impossible map each ask you to notice something different—and use what you learn to leave.

games.title: Golden Keep: Golden Ocean
games.description: Captain an enormous wooden hulk carrying sixty people to a new home. Study the chart, give sail orders and allow the crew time to answer. Walk the working decks and return to the helm as the weather changes: everyone aboard depends on the passage you choose.

games.title: Golden Keep: Golden Cliffs
games.description: Choose your holds, place your hands and feet, and shift your weight up the wall. Rest before the next reach. Beyond the first climb, the Lantern Road leads toward a refuge and the people making their lives along the cliffs.

games.title: Golden Keep: Jabberwocky
games.description: Create a human, orc, black dwarf or gargoyle and meet Golden Keep at a traveler’s height. Explore settlements, accept quests and choose your encounters. Gargoyles can take to the wind; on the ground, wounds and limited treatment give a fight consequences.

games.title: The Dark Between Stations
games.description: Ride the Night Line through dark carriages and unfamiliar stations. At each stop, leave the train to complete the work waiting outside. Keep the way back in mind: the platform is not empty, and the next departure is coming.

games.title: Inhospitable
games.description: Prepare beside the cabin fire, then venture into the snow to hunt and gather supplies. Drive the icy cliff road into town, keep yourself fed and warm, and make it home before an ordinary journey becomes a desperate one.

games.title: Your Happy Place
games.description: Search empty offices, tunnels and the ground outside for a way out. Collect coins, buy supplies and choose equipment for the hazards ahead. Familiar objects become useful tools in a place that no longer makes sense.

games.title: Echoes of Elsewhere
games.description: Journey through the Living Wilds, befriend creatures and restore its beacons. The complete game and its local save service are included. No Python installation or browser is needed.

games.title: Echoes of Elsewhere TCG
games.description: Build a creature deck, awaken its abilities and follow twelve keepers through a world waiting to be remembered. Play offline, with your collection saved on this computer.

games.title: War Table
games.description: Assign commanders and carry a campaign through research, purchases, movement, battle and income. The original rules engine, game workshop and required runtimes are included. Saved games stay on this computer.

games.title: Petscop
games.description: Garalina invites you into Petscop. Meet the Guardian, read the signs and look closely at the rooms around you. Catch the pets, keep a file of your progress and return when you have another idea.

games.title: WW2 Combat Footage Flight Simulator
games.description: Watch an archival approach over Rabaul harbor, then take control inside the latest small reconstructed scene. This development flight test includes the earlier photographic corridor. Combat and a wider world remain in development.

games.title: Poot-Poot
games.description: Explore Wonderwild Zoo and help six young animals find their way home. The launcher includes everything needed for offline play.

games.title: Pod-racing foundation
games.description: Build a hover racer from six craft families and modular engines, chassis, cooling and controls. Race six rivals through four very different routes, with assisted handling or direct control of both engines.

games.title: Power Towers
games.description: Build a defensive maze and route enemies through numbered gates. Land furnaces consume nearby grass; hydro wheels belong on water. Every building stores its own energy, and every directed power line must be made by hand.

games.title: The Ninth Sea
games.description: A wooden rowboat opens onto six impossible seas. There is no coast, the floor is beyond your breath, and the stone king moves when nobody is watching. Finish the Boat campaign to uncover a second recording: six very different aircraft crossing an impossible sky.

games.title: SCHWARZKAMM · Black Ridge
games.description: Fly Operation Abendlied: a continuous fifteen-minute bomber sortie through nine phases, with a 512-aircraft formation, coordinated interceptions, a bombing run and withdrawal. German crew recordings and English or German captions accompany the flight. The seven-base archive campaign is included.
